verdict.rationale: The DOS site says a form and instructions for the Certificate of Incorporation can be obtained from the Department of State website (docs-15). The incorporation page points to that form ("You are not required to use this form") and gives field-level instructions (docs-6, docs-7). It also references a Credit Card/Debit Card Authorization Form to submit with paper filings (docs-9), and these pages were fetched publicly. Missing for 10: an explicit downloadable PDF/link listing for the forms, an explicit statement that no account is needed, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the download.
